title: Experiment and data
text: Source: run_manifest.json. AAPL data from 2010-01-04 to 2026-10-01; 4212 raw rows, 4192 usable rows. Historical test: 2024-04-01 to 2026-10-01, 629 days. Seeds: 42, 123, 2026. Runtime 4.10 minutes. No new live forecast is served by this saved-results web application.

title: Methodology and leakage
text: Source: audited notebook. Base parameters are selected before 70% of the data. OOF base forecasts cover 70–85%; meta-selection uses the first 65% of OOF rows. Three later prospective meta-validation blocks precede final test. Final test labels do not select hyperparameters. Neural windows contain 60 historical days and nine features. Ridge and XGBoost predict price levels. GJR-GARCH forecasts conditional volatility, not price direction. All 11 programmed temporal and alignment checks passed; this is not a proof of every possible leakage risk.

title: Interpretation and limitations
text: Source: READ_ME_RESULTS.md. Ridge seed 42 DA 44.99%, compared with Transformer 53.26% and majority-direction baseline 55.33%. Ridge predicted a decrease on 94.44% of test days. XGBoost price forecasts remained approximately 165.29–192.45 while actual test closes ranged 165.00–341.07. Ensemble improvement was not demonstrated. The historical test era was viewed in earlier experiments, so it is not a new confirmatory holdout. Vendor point-in-time price provenance is not independently verified. Return-target meta-learning is a proposed new experiment, not an implemented performance improvement.

title: Explainability methods
text: Ridge contributions are exact additive linear attributions relative to the mean scaled OOF meta-training vector: contribution_j = coefficient_j * (scaled_input_j - mean_scaled_training_j). The expected prediction at this reference plus all contributions equals the price forecast. XGBoost explanations use the native TreeSHAP contribution algorithm. Its baseline plus signed contributions reconstructs the predicted price. These explain the meta-model, not the internal neural networks, and are not causal effects. Contribution magnitudes are in price units. The full input window remains historical.

title: Uncertainty
text: Source: audited notebook. Directional accuracy compares sign(predicted close minus previous actual close) with sign(actual close minus previous actual close). Exact zero is a neutral class. Moving-block bootstrap uses 1000 resamples, central block length 9 with sensitivity checks. Paired comparisons use identical resampled days; family-adjusted intervals use at least 5000 resamples. These are intervals for aggregate directional accuracy, not next-day price intervals or a probability that an individual prediction is correct.
